newsitem.title: ITALY: Police smash suspected Mafia ship-building scam.
newsitem.headline: Police smash suspected Mafia ship-building scam.

text.p: Police said on Saturday they had smashed two organised crime rings in dawn swoops in southern mainland Italy and Sicily, arresting scores of suspected mobsters.
Fifteen were held in connection with an investigation into the Mafia's virtual stranglehold over the ship-building industry in Palermo.
Magistrates conducting the probe, which is based on testimony by a former trade union leader and mob turncoats, suspect the Mafia has systematically won contracts from state shipbuilder Fincantieri.
In southwestern Calabria some 50 people suspected of running a heroin ring in the region's capital, Reggio Calabria, were held.
Both operations came a day after the government approved a plan to send 500 troops to Naples to help police crack down on gangsters who are plaguing the southern port with bloody turf wars.
The troops were to begin deployment early on Monday, police said on Saturday.
